title_template: {work_unit_id} — Assess Wave 6 Human-by-Exception pipeline health/drift under existing authority only
goal: Prepare a deterministic read-only Provider Truth health/drift assessment for the Wave 6 Human-by-Exception control plane, with explicit exception routing and no scheduling, mutation, runtime, product, release, ruleset/security or ADWF authority.
scope: re-read fresh public GitHub Provider Truth for main, open canonical Work Units, pull requests, workflow/check state, rulesets and canonical provider-state before every assessment
compare current governance, authority and continuity anchors with their canonical expected identities and classify material drift deterministically
produce a machine-readable read-only health/drift assessment that distinguishes HEALTHY, DRIFT_DETECTED, OWNER_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED and BLOCKED outcomes
route any authority, security, runtime, release, ruleset, ADWF or product boundary to an explicit no-mutation owner exception
prove the assessment performs no provider mutation and creates no periodic scheduling or unattended execution authority
forbidden_scope: create or enable periodic schedules, unattended mutation loops or new higher-autonomy authority
create, infer or broaden issue, branch, pull-request, writer-lease, merge or provider-state mutation authority
mutate product/runtime source, physical Windows/Keenetic/VPS runtime or 1080/1081 lifecycle
mutate ADWF binding/repository, release/tag/promotion, ruleset/security/trust policy or PRIVATE evidence
modify immutable materialization planner, policy, reusable grant, selector, schema or roadmap anchors
exit_criteria: fresh Provider Truth is required and stale provider snapshots are rejected
governance and authority anchor drift is classified deterministically without mutation
HEALTHY, DRIFT_DETECTED, OWNER_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED and BLOCKED remain distinct machine-readable outcomes
periodic scheduling and unattended mutation authority remain explicitly absent
no product/runtime, release/tag, ruleset/security, ADWF, PRIVATE evidence or 1080/1081 mutation occurs
exact-head hosted CI passes for the bounded repository-only Work Unit
